title: Mojo and MAX Go Fully Open for Commercial Use
summary:
The Mojo programming language and the MAX toolset are now accessible for commercial development and extension. The release covers the full Mojo language, the MAX graph compiler, MLRT runtime internals, and hardware abstraction logic.

Chris Lattner shared the update on Oct. 23, stating the opening of the stack is intended to facilitate the creation of AI agents.
